components.name: Book
responsibilities: Represent the Book aggregate root persisted in the 'books' table
Map columns: id (UUID primary key), isbn (unique, @NotBlank), title (@NotBlank), author (@NotBlank)
Carry bean-validation constraints (@NotNull on id, @NotBlank on isbn/title/author) enforced on persistence boundaries

components.name: CreateBookRequest
responsibilities: Immutable inbound DTO for book registration
Declare validation rules @NotBlank isbn, @NotBlank title, @NotBlank author
Decouple the REST contract from the Book entity

components.name: UpdateBookTitleRequest
responsibilities: Immutable inbound DTO for title modification keyed by ISBN path variable
Declare validation rule @NotBlank on title to reject empty/blank titles

components.name: BookResponse
responsibilities: Immutable outbound DTO exposing id, isbn, title, author
Serialize generated UUID and updated book details to API clients

components.name: DuplicateIsbnException
responsibilities: Signal a uniqueness violation on the Book ISBN natural key
Carry a message indicating duplicate ISBN for HTTP 400 mapping

components.name: BookNotFoundException
responsibilities: Signal that no Book exists for a supplied ISBN
Carry a message indicating the book was not found for HTTP 404 mapping

components.name: InvalidTitleException
responsibilities: Signal a business-level blank/empty title rejection not caught by bean validation
Carry a message indicating title cannot be empty for HTTP 400 mapping

components.name: BookRepository
responsibilities: Extend JpaRepository<Book, UUID> for CRUD persistence of the Book aggregate
Declare findByIsbn(String isbn) returning Optional<Book>
Declare existsByIsbn(String isbn) for unique-ISBN pre-checks
Declare deleteByIsbn(String isbn) for removal by natural key

components.name: BookService
responsibilities: Register a book: reject duplicate ISBN via BookRepository.existsByIsbn and persist a new Book with generated UUID
Update title by ISBN: load via findByIsbn, reject blank title, persist changed title
Retrieve book details by ISBN, mapping Book to BookResponse
Delete book by ISBN, raising BookNotFoundException when absent
Transactional boundary (@Transactional) for write operations and entity-to-DTO mapping

components.name: BookController
responsibilities: Expose POST /api/v1/books, PUT /api/v1/books/{isbn}, GET /api/v1/books/{isbn}, DELETE /api/v1/books/{isbn}
Apply @Valid on CreateBookRequest and UpdateBookTitleRequest payloads
Delegate exclusively to BookService and return 201, 200, 200, 204 respectively
Perform no persistence or business logic; depend only on the service layer

components.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
responsibilities: Map DuplicateIsbnException and InvalidTitleException to HTTP 400 with an error message body
Map BookNotFoundException to HTTP 404 with an error message body
Map MethodArgumentNotValidException / ConstraintViolationException to HTTP 400 with field-level validation errors
Map unexpected Throwable to HTTP 500 with a generic sanitized error response

endpoints.summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, non-empty title and non-empty author; returns the created book with its generated UUID
Update the title of the book identified by ISBN; rejects blank titles and unknown ISBNs
Retrieve book details by ISBN; returns 404 when no book matches the ISBN
Delete the book identified by ISBN from the catalog; returns 204 No Content on success

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Audit Library API
  description: Auto-generated API contracts for audit-library conforming to Spring
    Boot 3 / Java 21 Records.
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
- url: http://localhost:8080
  description: Local server
paths:
  /api/v1/books:
    post:
      summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, non-empty title and non-empty
        author; returns the created book with its generated UUID
      operationId: post_api_v1_books
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateBookRequest'
  /api/v1/books/{isbn}:
    put:
      summary: Update the title of the book identified by ISBN; rejects blank titles
        and unknown ISBNs
      operationId: put_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateBookTitleRequest'
    get:
      summary: Retrieve book details by ISBN; returns 404 when no book matches the
        ISBN
      operationId: get_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
    delete:
      summary: Delete the book identified by ISBN from the catalog; returns 204 No
        Content on success
      operationId: delete_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Successful operation
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetails:
      type: object
      required:
      - timestamp
      - status
      - message
      properties:
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          type: integer
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    BookResponse:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record response for Book
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        isbn: &id001
          type: string
        title: &id002
          type: string
        author: &id003
          type: string
    CreateBookRequest:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record request with Jakarta validation for Book
      required:
      - isbn
      - title
      - author
      properties:
        isbn: *id001
        title: *id002
        author: *id003

userStories.intent: register a new book with a unique ISBN, title, and author
userStories.benefit: maintain an accurate and up-to-date library catalog

scenarios.given: a librarian provides valid book details with a unique ISBN, non-empty title, and non-empty author
scenarios.when: the librarian submits a request to register the book
scenarios.then: the system creates the book and returns HTTP 201 with the created book details including the generated UUID

scenarios.given: a book already exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to register another book with the same ISBN
scenarios.then: the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating duplicate ISBN

scenarios.given: a librarian provides book details with an empty title
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to register the book
scenarios.then: the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty

userStories.intent: update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: correct or modify book information as needed

scenarios.given: a book exists with a known ISBN and a non-empty new title
scenarios.when: the librarian updates the book title by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system updates the title and returns HTTP 200 with the updated book details

scenarios.given: no book exists for a given ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to update its title
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found

scenarios.given: a book exists with a known ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to update the title to an empty string
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty

userStories.intent: retrieve book details by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: find information about a specific book in the library

scenarios.given: a book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 200 with the book details

scenarios.given: no book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found

userStories.intent: delete a book from the library catalog by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: remove outdated or lost books from the system

scenarios.given: a book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian deletes the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system removes the book and returns HTTP 204 No Content

scenarios.given: no book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to delete it
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found
